channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Zelenskyy says Russia fired over 200 drones at Ukraine as truce expires
item.description: One killed and four others wounded in attacks on Ukraine's Dnipropetrovsk region, local administration chief says.

item.title: Iran war: What’s happening on day 74 as Tehran says ready for ‘aggression’
item.description: US-Iran tensions remain high as Tehran warns against 'aggression' and Trump says the ceasefire is on 'life support'.

item.title: Global energy crisis highlights meagre oil buffers in developing world
item.description: Governments in the Global South are among the least prepared to respond to the oil shock caused by the Iran war.

item.title: Lebanese in south refuse to flee again despite escalating Israeli strikes
item.description: Obaida Hitto reports from southern Lebanon, where residents say they will not leave again despite intensifying strikes.

item.title: Trump says Iran ceasefire is on 'massive life support'
item.description: The US president criticises an Iranian counteroffer to end the war, and says the month-long ceasefire is "unbelievably weak".

item.title: Snack giant switches to black and white packaging as Iran war hits ink supplies
item.description: The effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz has severely disrupted global supplies of energy and petrochemicals.

item.title: Pakistan struck a rehab centre and killed 269 Afghans. Their families want to know why
item.description: There are calls to investigate the 16 March airstrike - which the UN says likely killed more - as a war crime.

item.title: Israel passes law to allow death penalty and public trials for those linked to 7 October
item.description: Israel passes a law that permits the death penalty and public trials for those involved in the unprecedented Hamas-led attacks.

item.title: EU agrees sanctions on Israeli settlers over West Bank violence
item.description: The EU's foreign policy chief said "extremism and violence carry consequences", while Israel branded the move "arbitrary".

item.title: Whales could be harmed by diverted ships avoiding Middle East, scientists warn
item.description: Ships have rerouted around the Cape of Good Hope since 2023 to avoid conflicts in the Middle East.
